provenance: Hand-authored 2026-08-18 for the CTO-authorized M11 targeted boundary experiment (paired with boundary_pair1_b_notapplicable_guidance_absent). Synthetic figures, not real disclosed data. Pair isolates one variable: whether the evidence contains ANY forward-looking guidance statement at all. Case A is the 'applicable' member of the pair -- evidence directly addresses the claim's forward-looking subject.
claim: Management guided to double-digit revenue growth for the next fiscal year.
evidence: 10-K excerpt, Item 7 (MD&A): Management stated it expects net sales growth of 10% to 12% for the next fiscal year, citing a strong order backlog and continued demand across all major product categories.
reference_rationale: The evidence directly states forward guidance of 10-12% net sales growth, which is double-digit growth -- a direct, unambiguous match to the claim's assertion. Independently justified from the evidence text alone, not constructed to force a contrast with Case B.
